_doc: THE THALAMUS CANON (CYBORG_BRAIN.md §4) — salience weights, tier thresholds, binding window, refractory, budget coupling. Approval-gated: changing these shapes what the organism ATTENDS to (curriculum-shaping), so edits ride the same human-approval law as the genome. Weights are calibrated so a voiced doubt on a fresh concept, or a confident-wrong rep on a fresh concept, crosses tau1 and wakes Opus — while a Governor flip or a due card alone never does (biometrics weight attention, never drive verdicts). Prosody/emotion/affect are EXCLUDED from scoring by construction (stripped at the door in code, not here).
_repair_2026_08_04: ORGANISM REPAIR (issues #1 #2 #6 #9 #10). #1: SELF now gates on PROVENANCE (self_sources / self_deny_sources) instead of modality:'voice' — the mic has been silent since 30 Jul while his typed doubts landed in a scorer that was blind to them (3,099 code moments in salience_ledger, max S 0.000). #2a: base_rates gained a MEASURED 'pulse:*' prefix entry — the 0.5 default made a rare escalation maximally UNSURPRISING and capped the whole pulse lane at 0.24375 against tau0 0.25. #2c: weights.pulse exists and is 0.00 on purpose; see the arithmetic in scripts/thalamus.mjs DEFAULT_CONFIG. #6: whisper.canon_join + whisper.sprint_fallback give the DMN precache a join key that can actually bind. NOTHING in tiers/hab was touched — the wake bar, the epsilon band and habituation are exactly as the captain left them.

pe._base_rates_doc: p = how OFTEN this event_key actually happens. Rare => high surprisal => high PE. Keys ending in '*' are prefix wildcards (longest prefix wins). 'default': 0.5 is the coin-flip prior for an event nobody has measured — it is deliberately the WEAKEST possible evidence, and it must never be left standing for an event whose rate IS measurable. NOTE: only 'pulse:*' has been measured so far. 'context:*', 'stall:*', 'rep:*', 'gov:*', 'twin:*' and 'dead:due' are all still on the coin-flip default and all are measurable from the same ledgers — they were left alone deliberately, because changing them shifts scores across every lane at once and that belongs in its own change.
pe._base_rates_pulse_derivation: MEASURED, not chosen. brain_ledger.jsonl: 881 job='haiku_pulse' rows, 131 with escalated=true => p = 131/881 = 0.148695. Arithmetic that follows: surprisal(0.148695, 4 bits) = -log2(0.148695)/4 = 0.68738; base-rate PE is halved as weak evidence => 0.34370; x w_pe 0.35 => 0.12029. With nov=1 the pulse ceiling is now 0.12029 + 0.20 = 0.32029, ABOVE tau0 0.25 (it was 0.04375 + 0.20 = 0.24375, i.e. 0.006 short — every escalation in the organism's life was arithmetically incapable of leaving reflex). Replayed over the 106 historical pulse moments at their own measured nov/hab: 38 now cross tau0 and 36 land inside the epsilon band where the fail-closed Haiku adjudicator can promote them. Was 0 and 0. Re-derive from brain_ledger whenever the pulse's cadence or prompt changes.

_self_sources_doc: #1 — WHO SPOKE, not which pipe. Live voice afferents carry no 'source' field at all (measured across all 271), so a voice modality is its own provenance. 'claude-code' is hooks/afferent-post.mjs UserPromptSubmit = his words; 'organism-memory' is the MCP note tool = his words. The deny list WINS: 'claude-code-teaching' is the Stop hook, i.e. the organism's own answers coming back through the door — scoring the machine's talk about 'confusion' as HIS doubt is the same self-talk scar the capture guard was built to close. Verified on the live bus: of 237 claude-code rows since the 25 Jul capture-guard fix, exactly 6 fire a self_marker and all 6 are genuinely his.
_whisper_doc: #6 — the DMN precache join. legacy_raw is the ORIGINAL word-overlap matcher, kept first and unchanged; it will start firing the day presence.mjs sends real concepts instead of window-title words. canon_join pushes both sides through the same concepts.json registry the dossier already uses. sprint_fallback: when the stall's own words name nothing canonical (the measured everyday case — 0 of 95 stalls matched), the current sprint concept is used as the join key and the whisper records matched_via:'sprint' so the assumption is visible, never smuggled.
_log_doc: #10 — ArsenalFC-Thalamus runs under setup/hidden_run.vbs with no redirect, so every diagnostic went to a closed handle. max_bytes is DERIVED: salience_ledger.jsonl holds 5,481 bound moments over 16 days = 342.6/day; worst case one ~160-byte line per moment = 54.8 KB/day; 30 days of that worst case = 1,644,480 B. keep:1 bounds the disk cost at ~3.3 MB. scripts/*.log is gitignored.
